# Line-count conformance

<!-- Generated by tests/LineCounts.Oracle (`table`) from tests/line-counts/oracle.json and
     tests/line-counts/rulings.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

This table is the evidence behind [decision record 0010](adr/0010-line-counts.md). Each case
in `tests/line-counts/corpus` isolates one edge case. Each cell gives code/comments/blanks
as the tool counted the file, and `—` where the tool did not count it. The majority is the
triple at least two tools give exactly. The ruling is what Diffra's counter must give: the
majority, a deliberate divergence with its reason, or a question still open for the owner.

Tools: cloc 2.12, scc 4.1.0, tokei 14.0.0.

Of 70 cases, all three tools agree on 42, two agree on 24, and the three split on 4. Rulings: 66 majority, 0 diverge, 4 open.

Agreement between each pair of tools, over the cases both count:

| Pair | Same triple | Same code | Same comments | Same blanks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cloc and scc | 55 of 66 | 60 of 66 | 55 of 66 | 61 of 66 |
| cloc and tokei | 42 of 66 | 44 of 66 | 42 of 66 | 61 of 66 |
| scc and tokei | 53 of 70 | 53 of 70 | 53 of 70 | 70 of 70 |
